name: maxplus2-mcp
display_name: MAX+plus II MCP / 数字电路 AI 工具
description: MAX+plus II MCP: GDF/SYM/SCF editing, compile/simulation and Windows automation. 原理图、符号、波形编辑与编译仿真。
long_description: Agent-independent local MCP server for Altera MAX+plus II (MaxPlus2), with 68 tools for digital logic projects, GDF schematics, SYM symbols, SCF waveforms, original compilation/simulation and a standalone Win32/UIA backend. Supports any client that can launch a local stdio MCP server. Requires a separately installed, licensed MAX+plus II for native operations. 面向数字电路实验的本地 MCP 服务，无需 Codex Computer Use；原厂功能需要自行安装 MAX+plus II。

install_root.title: MAX+plus II installation / 软件安装目录
install_root.description: Directory containing your separately installed maxplus2.exe. 选择本机包含 maxplus2.exe 的安装目录。

workspace.title: Project workspace / 工程目录
workspace.description: Directory containing the projects you want the agent to work on. 选择需要 AI 处理的工程目录。
